status: Conditional recipe frozen while the third-seed replication is still running. No access to official test data unless replication_results.json official_release is true. Original historical official evaluations must be disclosed.
candidate: FULL; RESID failed the primary candidate retention rule. Score M0, OPS, FULL, and the same adapted CET. All four subsets; labels and model predictions clipped to [0,125] for official endpoint only. Positive bias means overestimating RUL.
training: Refit on all training engines once per subset and per seed 101,202,303, retaining the identical fixed 24 epoch stride-5 training recipe. OOF operating/full priors on train engines, scaler and prior estimators trained on train only. No use of official test to select an epoch, configuration, arm, or seed.
endpoints: Exactly the final observed cycle of each official test engine. Use only its observed history. If fewer than 50 cycles are available, left-pad the observed sensor window with its first real observation. Compute reference and history statistics on real observations only. Below the first prior cutoff 50 use the median lifetime of the training engines for both prior arms; otherwise use the last observed grid cutoff <= t. CET handcrafted window statistics use the padded input consistently.
sealing: Produce and hash immutable official predictions for all subsets/arms/seeds before reading any RUL_FDxxx labels. A single scoring step reports seed-specific endpoint RMSE and NASA score, with separately labeled three-seed prediction mean and engine-paired differences versus M0/OPS. No hyperparameter revision, test-score rescue or resubmission. Old E22a scores remain historical and use a different ensemble.
if_blocked: If the preregistered replication gate fails, record NO_RELEASE without reading official test files or training a substitute method.
